profile.headline: Edge Connect Team Lead
profile.summary:
Embedded Software Engineer with a variety of experience in interrupt driven and RTOS systems.  Experience with Bluetooth communication and low power battery operated low power.
Heavy focus on connecting mobile devices to hardware products through use of Bluetooth 4.x (Bluetooth SMART, Bluetooth Low Energy).
I also have experience developing embedded software to control auto brightness algorithms for LED backlight displays.

Specialties: Embedded Development, Software Architecture, ARM Architecture Development, C and C++, Object Oriented Design, Unit Testing

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Zephyr · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Service Provider Interface (SPI) · I2C

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer; Module Software Lead
positions.description:
Developed Bluetooth Low Energy interface libraries for both iOS and Android including over the air updates to devices.
Developed communications protocol for iOS to communicate with and control external hardware.
Developed iOS layer for updating hardware firmware from iOS applications using Bluetooth Low Energy.
Implemented USB host stack for direct endpoint communications.
Developed numerous Bluetooth 4.0 (Bluetooth Smart, Bluetooth Low Energy) firmware solutions for controlling various hardware platforms.
Developed Android Launcher application for client
Participated in creation of custom Android build/kernel for client hardware
Principal developler of MDB/DEX protocol implementations for VendScreen
Designed and developed Bluetooth ECG (electrocardiograph) firmware including required FDA robustness and documentation
Developed and released embedded test platforms to help contract manufacturers test our clients’ products
Developed other miscellaneous support software in C# to help configure client hardware
Developed firmware for Rigado designed USB signal generator
Developed C# application to receive data from a wireless power transmitter.
Developed a number of different PC based manufacturing test applications that interface to client product.

positions.title: Director of Firmware Engineering
positions.description: Skills: Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Service Provider Interface (SPI)

positions.title: Founder, Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lumenplay lights are the smartest string of lights you've ever experienced! They are multi-colored, Bluetooth SMART, energy efficient, long lasting LED lights that you control with your smart phone or tablet. Lumenplay gives you unprecedented control of your decorative lighting, reduces your energy costs and is designed last to for many years! Lumenplay delivers an amazing assortment of effects, games and music visualizers that you are sure to love.

Lumenplay began as an internal Rigado project that has grown into a company that is now shipping RGB sting lighting and licensing our technologies to other lighting companies. We are in the process of expanding our business to go after more licensing deals and expand our own product portfolio. We are currently seeking investment opportunities!

My role is to architect and develop all software and firmware for both the Lighting Controller and the iOS App.
positions.insights: Skills: Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Service Provider Interface (SPI) · I2C

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed ATmega48 power control solution using AVR Stuido.
Embedded software product development using C.
FAA DO178-B software certification and verification.
Embedded software driver level development for the GTN (Garmin Touchscreen Navigator) series.
Auto-brightness algorithm development for LED back-lit touchscreen.
positions.insights: Skills: Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Service Provider Interface (SPI) · I2C

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed common Database access layer in C# to be used by numerous applications in an application suite.
Developed large scale fire system configuration application using C#.
Released two updated versions of an embedded Linux device (using the vxWorks operating system).
Maintained automated test suite.
Wrote Java web interface for displaying and processing events from fire systems.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
High Energy Physics (Sept 03 to Dec 05):
Developed software algorithms that search electron positron (e+ e-) collisions to verify theoretical Lambda particle lifetime with experimental and simulated data.

Helped set up software/hardware environment for laboratory.

Bioinformatics (Jan 06  to May 06):
Developed dynamic programming algorithm to determine similarity between two DNA sequences.
